checks.text: The page displays the heading "Receipt Tracker" and, with no receipts, shows the text "No receipts yet".

Filling the field labelled "Merchant" with "Grocery Store", the field labelled "Amount" with "50.00", choosing "Food" in the select labelled "Category", and clicking the button "Add receipt" adds a row to the table containing "Grocery Store", "$50.00", and "Food". The text "No receipts yet" is no longer visible.
After adding a second receipt with Merchant "Office Supplies", Amount "25.50", and Category "Office", the table contains two rows. The summary line "Total: $75.50" is visible.
Typing "Grocery" in the search box labelled "Search" filters the table to show only the row containing "Grocery Store". The row for "Office Supplies" is not visible.
Selecting "Office" in the filter select labelled "Category" shows only the row containing "Office Supplies". The row for "Grocery Store" is not visible.
Clicking the button "Delete Grocery Store" removes that row from the table. The summary line updates to "Total: $25.50".

Clicking the button "Export CSV" downloads a file named "receipts.csv" containing the header "Merchant,Category,Amount" and a line "Grocery Store,Food,50.00" (assuming the Grocery Store receipt was not deleted in A6, or re-added).
Filling the field labelled "Merchant" with "Empty" and clicking "Add receipt" without entering an Amount shows the error message "Amount is required" and adds no row to the table.
Reload keeps the receipt with Merchant "Office Supplies" and Amount "$25.50" visible in the table.
